PROP-attendanceze-pre-007.text: authCallback must verify user exists in member.members table before allowing dashboard access.
PROP-attendanceze-pre-007.assertion: forall cb: redirect_dashboard(cb) => exists(member.members WHERE discord_uid = cb.discord_uid)

locations.note: Auth callback does NOT check member.members table — it redirects to dashboard without membership verification. Member lookup happens lazily at dashboard page load.
Member profile lookup (line 75-79) and redirect to /dashboard/register if not found (line 162-164). This is where membership is enforced, not in the callback.
